title: Persian's Face Has a Built-In Off Switch
premise: Persian senses nearby air movements with six whiskers, but grabbing them makes this vicious Pokémon docile.
audiencePromise: See how Persian's danger-sensing whiskers become the exact trigger that calms it.
openLoop: How can a vicious cat become docile through its own whiskers?
payoff: Persian's design turns one face feature into a perfect contradiction: it reads nearby air, then becomes docile when grabbed.
engagementQuestion: Would you try the whisker trick, or avoid Persian completely?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan telling a friend something wild. Keep the pace quick, warm, and playful. Stress the contradiction between Persian's vicious nature and its docile whisker response. Pause briefly before each reveal.

scenes.headline: PERSIAN HAS A FACE OFF SWITCH
scenes.narration: Persian has an off switch on its face.

scenes.headline: SIX WHISKERS READ THE AIR
scenes.narration: Its six bold whiskers sense nearby air movements around it.
scenes.caption: IT FEELS THE AIR MOVE

scenes.headline: TAIL UP MEANS POUNCE
scenes.narration: When its tail rises, Persian signals the attack is coming.
scenes.caption: TAIL UP = POUNCE AND BITE

scenes.headline: GRAB THE WHISKERS
scenes.narration: The Pokédex gives Persian one bizarre calming rule: grab them.
scenes.caption: GRAB THEM. PERSIAN CALMS.

scenes.headline: THE SENSOR IS THE OFF SWITCH
scenes.narration: The face that reads nearby air carries the strangest calm response.
scenes.caption: AIR SENSOR → CALM RESPONSE
